instruction: Stand the red pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:

obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Grasp red pen near its top/end to allow insertion, or choose best candidate
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
# Filter or sort candidates; prefer grasping across short axis (finger fits, squeeze_width small)
valid = [c for c in candidates if c["fits_open_fingers"]]
# Grasp candidate with highest score or appropriate orientation
best_cand = max(valid, key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0))
grasp(best_cand)

# Move above pen holder high enough to clear rim
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)

# To insert vertically, align pen vertically if held horizontally,
# or lower into cup and release
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()

check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")

# Move up safely

# Pitch gripper so the held pen points vertically downward
# When grasped across width, object lies along 'side' = approach x finger_axis.

# Lower vertically into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.08)
open_gripper()

retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")
